text: Theoretically a pyramid scheme does work, in the sense that the people who come in early or in the middle, or whoever gets in before the balloon blows up, can make a lot of money. But it's always a non-stationary, not stable equilibrium. Meaning that it needs to be constantly feeding itself. It's not like a tree which has constant inputs and constant outputs. It's always growing. So eventually either it hits a plateau where there's no more potential recruitment, or the rate of growth of the recruitment becomes less than the rate of growth of the withdrawals. And then the balloon blows up and everything goes to zero. So all pyramid schemes in the end are doomed to collapse and blow up. But the early entrants do make money.
